_what: Settings of src/take-me-there.mjs (tool:take-me-there). `link`: the address a notice carries opens the arrangement and starts the tour (the page reads `layout` and `tour` from its address, src/workspace/main.tsx); `base` only makes a card's relative address whole to read its path. The notice kind is a row of records/tell-the-person.json. The arrangement and walkthrough are kept under `category`. `focus_sizes`: the thing's pane against what is put beside it. `fallback_points_at`: where the walkthrough points when the Waiting on you row names no control of its own (`points_at` on a row of src/waiting-on-you.json). `step_id`, `step_icon`, `step_placement`: the walkthrough step made when the caller gives none.

words.needs_thing: Say which thing to take them to: thing, the id of one card from tool:what-is-waiting-on-me (make it first, such as draft_post for a post to approve).
words.not_waiting: {thing} is not waiting on them now (it is not made yet, or it is already done), so nothing was opened: make it first, then take them to it with the id tool:what-is-waiting-on-me gives.
words.outside: {thing} opens outside Trillion ({address}), so nothing was opened; give them that address instead.
words.opened: Their open Trillion page opens on {title}.
words.told: They were told, with a link that opens it on any device.
